question: In March 2025, who inaugurated the two-day National Conference on ‘Environment – 2025’ in New Delhi?
solution:
The correct answer is __**President of India**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **President of India**, **Smt. Droupadi Murmu**, inaugurated the two-day **National Conference on ‘Environment – 2025’** held in **New Delhi** in **March 2025**.
 
• The conference was organized to address the pressing **global environmental challenges** and to formulate a roadmap for **sustainable development** in the coming decade.
 
• During the inauguration, the **President** highlighted the urgent need for **climate justice** and the protection of **biodiversity**, emphasizing that humanity's survival depends on a healthy planet.
 
• The event served as a high-level forum bringing together **environmentalists**, **scientists**, **policymakers**, and **judicial experts** to discuss the integration of **traditional ecological knowledge** with **modern science**.
 
• The conference focused on India's progress toward achieving its **Nationally Determined Contributions (NDCs)** under the **Paris Agreement** and the country's commitment to reaching **Net Zero** carbon emissions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change (MoEFCC):**
 
 
• This is the nodal agency of the **Central Government** responsible for the planning and coordination of **India's environmental policies**.
 
• The ministry oversees the implementation of various acts such as the **Environment (Protection) Act, 1986** and the **Wildlife Protection Act, 1972**.
 
 
 
• **Constitutional Mandate:**
 
 
• **Article 48A**: A **Directive Principle of State Policy** which states that the State shall endeavor to protect and improve the **environment** and to safeguard the **forests** and **wildlife** of the country.
 
• **Article 51A(g)**: A **Fundamental Duty** of every citizen to protect and improve the natural environment including **forests, lakes, rivers, and wildlife**.
 
 
 
• **Mission LiFE (Lifestyle for Environment):**
 
 
• Launched by the **Prime Minister of India**, this initiative promotes a **circular economy** and encourages individuals to adopt sustainable lifestyles to mitigate **climate change**.
 
• It aims to replace the prevalent 'use-and-dispose' economy with a 'circular economy' defined by mindful and deliberate utilization.
 
 
 
• **National Green Tribunal (NGT):**
 
 
• Established in **2010** under the **NGT Act**, it is a specialized body equipped with the necessary expertise to handle **environmental disputes** involving multi-disciplinary issues.
 
• It provides a fast-track mechanism for cases related to **environmental protection** and conservation of forests.
 
 
 
• **International Solar Alliance (ISA):**
 
 
• Headquartered in **Gurugram, India**, this alliance was jointy launched by **India** and **France** to mobilize efforts against **climate change** through the deployment of **solar energy** solutions.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Panchamrit Strategy**: At **COP26**, India announced five nectar elements (**Panchamrit**) to deal with **climate change**, including reaching **500 GW** of non-fossil energy capacity by **2030**.
 
• **Carbon Credit Trading Scheme**: India is developing its own **carbon market** to incentivize **greenhouse gas** emission reductions and promote **green technology**.
 
• **World Environment Day**: Celebrated annually on **June 5**, it serves as the principal vehicle of the **United Nations** for encouraging awareness and action for the protection of the **environment**.
